scope: Pinned upstream comparison for the private Ready-image materialization increment; no public placement or snapshot acceptance.

sources.application: Resolve from persistence, enforce namespace and Ready state, then derive the effective image/backend before dispatch. This is a comparison, not evidence for GoldenHoop runtime behavior.
Keep immutable image content separate from each VM writable disk; use the copy-based approach as the correctness baseline before optimizing storage.

dependency_decision: No dependency on the archived project; compare its device-image separation only. GoldenHoop keeps production implementation in Rust.
local_rules: Only exact Ready jobs and administrator-pinned guest/converter inventory are consumed.
Keep the existing preparation/collection lock across the complete verified copy.
Use a root-private O_TMPFILE descriptor, without a named staging fallback; consumer owns its independent disk copy.
No host paths, private blob references, provider observations or storage credentials in ReadyImageInfo.
Public API/SDK image placement and per-generation native selection are still unimplemented.
